description: Book a non-diagnostic elective 2D/3D/4D ultrasound scan appointment directly at Bump to Baby Montana. Persists booking to Cloudflare D1 and triggers automated confirmation SMS & Email. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'create_booking' on Bump to Baby Store (bumptobabysa.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_studio_info' or 'get_scan_packages_and_pricing' or 'get_gestational_guide' for their respective operations). Parameters: customer_name (required), customer_phone (required), customer_email (optional), service_type (required), date (required), time (required), gestation_weeks (optional), notes (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Creates a live record/session in the backend database; no authentication required for public initiation; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

customer_email.description: Email address for detailed appointment confirmation and calendar invite. Optional.

customer_name.description: Full name of the expectant parent (e.g. "Sarah van der Merwe") [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

customer_phone.description: South African mobile number for SMS confirmation (e.g. "0821234567" or "+27821234567") [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

gestation_weeks.description: Gestational age of pregnancy in weeks (must be 12 weeks or higher) [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

notes.description: Any special requests (e.g. "Bringing grandma and big brother", "Secret gender reveal envelope"). Optional.

service_type.description: Service package name: "Gender Scan (30min - R600)", "4D Scan (45min - R850)", or "2D Scan (30min - R500)" [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

time.description: Appointment start time in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g. "09:30", "14:00")

name: create_booking
title: Create Booking
